description: This file defines the ViewFactory class, which is responsible for creating and managing view handlers in the OFBiz web application framework. It loads view handlers based on configuration and provides access to them by type.

classes.name: ViewFactory
classes.description: Factory class for managing view handlers in the web application.

methods.name: ViewFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes view handlers based on configuration.

methods.name: getViewHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a view handler by its type, throws exception if not found.
